thread.title: Stock Market News: Nasdaq Leads Up Session, Helped By Biotech Stocks |

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Stock Market News: Nasdaq Leads Up Session, Helped By Biotech Stocks |
text:
Technology stocks led the way in afternoon trading Friday after the S&P 500 confirmed a new rally with a follow-through day. In stock market news today, FANG stocks Amazon.com ( AMZN ) and Netflix ( NFLX ) outperformed, while Eli Lilly ( LLY ) edged higher on news of a big acquisition.
X The Nasdaq composite was up 1.2%, the S&P 500 rallied 0.8%, and the Dow Jones industrial average added 0.5%. Volume on the NYSE and Nasdaq was tracking very close to Friday's levels. ( For updates on this story and other market coverage, visit the Stock Market Today page.)
Stock market bulls certainly liked the look of Friday's huge percentage gains for the Dow Jones, S&P 500 and Nasdaq composite. What they didn't like was lower volume on the Nasdaq and sluggish performance among leading growth stocks.
The IBD 50 rose 4% Friday, slightly lagging the Nasdaq' s 4.2% gain. Breakouts were sparse, and the top-rated growth stocks moving higher in heavy volume where in very short supply. The takeaway was that institutional investors were not putting money to work in growth stocks.
Stock Market News: Monday's Gainers Retail stocks and biotech stocks outperformed Monday. Utilities lagged.
Dollar General ( DG ) jumped 3.6% to 112.37 as it tries to clear a double-bottom base with a 113.25 entry. KeyBank upgraded shares to overweight with a 125 price target.
Among biotechs, Innoviva ( INVA ) flirted with an all-time high as it tried to break out from a short consolidation. Shares were up nearly 3% to 18.31.
IShares Nasdaq Biotechnology Index ( IBB ) was poised for its seventh gain in eight sessions. Shares were up 3.5% Monday, good for a breakout over a trend line.
In M&A news, Eli Lilly announced plans to buy Loxo Oncology ( LOXO ) for around $8 billion, or $235 a share. That's a big premium to Loxo's Friday close of 139.87. Shares of Loxo soared 66%. Eli Lilly edged higher after an early swoon.
Stock Market News: 2 FANGs On The Move Among the FANG stocks , Amazon picked up 3% to 1,624, helped by a buy rating from Pivotal Research and 1,920 price target. Amazon's 200-day moving average of around 1,700 is a potential resistance level to watch.
Netflix extended gains after soaring nearly 10% Friday. Shares were up 5%. Netflix gapped above its 50-day moving average Friday after Goldman Sachs added the stock to its "Conviction Buy" list.
But Apple ( AAPL ) didn't participate in Monday's rally despite news that the company struck a deal with Samsung to distribute iTunes shows on Samsung smart TVs. Shares were down nearly 1%.
Three enterprise software stocks were top gainers in the MarketSmith Growth 250 . Twilio ( TWLO ), Five9 ( FIVN ) and Leaderboard stock Atlassian ( TEAM ) showed gains ranging from 8% to 10%.
The week is heavy on Fed speeches. On Wednesday, Atlanta Fed President Raphael Bostic, Chicago Fed President Charles Evans and Boston Fed President Eric Rosengren are scheduled to speak. Later in the day, the minutes from the Dec. 19 Fed meeting will be released at 2 p.m. ET.
Fed Chairman Jerome Powell speaks Thursday.
